title: Akusalam dhammam
text: 1.2. Sāvatthi || || Tatravoca || || 3. Akusale ca vo bhikkhave dhamme desissāmi kusale ca dhamme || tam suṇātha || || 4. Katame ca bhikkhave akusalā dhammā || seyyathīdaṃ || Micchādiṭṭhi || pa || micchāsamādhi || || Ime vuccanti bhikkhave kusalā dhammā ti || || 5. Katame- -kusalā dhammā- -Sammādiṭṭhi || pa || sammāsamādhi || || Ime- -kusalā dhammā ti || ||
